moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-rgb-split-glitch, written here): Two copies over the text, each clipped to a horizontal band. CSS: cyan copy (x −2 px, cyan shadow +5 px) on a 2 s cycle, red copy (x +2, red shadow −5 px) on 3 s; bands slide through 6 inset keys (20/50, 60/12, 43/40, 8/78, 70/6, 32/55 %), linear alternate-reverse. Canvas demo (12 fps): bursts only in 0.35–1.05 / 2.4–2.78 s on ~70 % of frames: red band in the upper half, cyan in the lower (6–22 % tall), shifted −/+4–12 px, screen blend; text jitters ±2 px. Loop 3 s. Params: offset: độ lệch (5–12 px) · band: chiều cao dải (6–22 %) · cycles: chu kỳ hai bản (2 s / 3 s) · seed. In a burst about 70 % of frames glitch: a red band in the upper half, a cyan band in the lower, shifted opposite ways.
